audit.why: 52.3% over 1371 games; EVEN 5.5/10 holds. The lane is a spacing problem: Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1 and The Weirding hops her backward on 15s, both of which beat a 450-range W.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept; the two escape cooldowns named where the advice needs them.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] read 'Aurora', matching the packet levelChart — two rows disagreeing across layers, with whys still describing Lissandra owning both item stages.
audit.why: Her item scaling adds a dodge to every engage you own and a Between Worlds zone she can teleport across; your claw is still 12s at rank 5. Level 6 remains Lissandra's on both layers.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[5..6].side to Aurora at 4/10 as one atomic group with rewritten whys; win[5..6] already read Aurora so no cross-layer disagreement is introduced.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: The Weirding hops her backward after the blast, so it disengages your 450-range W even when Across the Veil is down; and Spirit Abjuration heals her off every spell and attack she lands, so extended chip trades refund themselves.
audit.why: Riot text on E: 'damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety'. Riot text on P: exorcised spirits follow her and heal her.
audit.corrected: The Weirding's backward hop written into breakdown.cooldowns and enemyWin; the sustain and its Grievous Wounds answer into dontsFull[2].d.
